summary.ru: Предлоги после прилагательных: чувства и оценки, способности и качества, сходство и зависимость. Ключевые модели — прилагательное + предлог (afraid of, good at, interested in, similar to, dependent on).
summary.en: Prepositions after adjectives: feelings and opinions, abilities and qualities, similarity and dependence. The key pattern is adjective + preposition (afraid of, good at, interested in, similar to, dependent on).

body.ru: Страх: **afraid / frightened / scared / terrified of**. Гнев и раздражение: **angry / annoyed / furious about** ситуация и **with somebody for** поступок. Волнение и восторг: **worried / nervous / excited / upset about**.
body.en: Fear: **afraid / frightened / scared / terrified of**. Anger: **angry / annoyed / furious about** a situation and **with somebody for** an action. Worry and excitement: **worried / nervous / excited / upset about**.

examples: Are you afraid of spiders?
She was angry with me for being late.
I'm a bit worried about the exam.
They were excited about the trip.
exampleTranslations: Ты боишься пауков?
Она злилась на меня за опоздание.
Я немного волнуюсь из-за экзамена.
Они были в восторге от поездки.

body.ru: О поступке: **nice / kind / good / generous / polite / rude / honest / stupid / silly of somebody** (to do something); об отношении: **nice / kind / good / generous / friendly / polite / rude / cruel to somebody**. Недовольство: **fed up / bored with**, **tired of**. Сочувствие: **feel sorry for somebody**; сожаление: **sorry for / about** поступок, **I'm sorry I did it**.
body.en: An action: **nice / kind / good / generous / polite / rude / honest / stupid / silly of somebody** (to do something); treatment: **nice / kind / good / generous / friendly / polite / rude / cruel to somebody**. Dissatisfaction: **fed up / bored with**, **tired of**. Sympathy: **feel sorry for somebody**; regret: **sorry for / about** something you did, **I'm sorry I did it**.

examples: It was very kind of you to help me.
They have always been nice to me.
I'm fed up with this cold weather.
I'm sorry about the mess.
exampleTranslations: Было очень любезно с твоей стороны помочь мне.
Они всегда хорошо ко мне относились.
Мне надоела эта холодная погода.
Извини за беспорядок.

body.ru: Умение: **good / bad / brilliant / hopeless at**; возможность: **capable / incapable of**; интерес: **interested in**, **keen on**; успех: **successful in**. Качества: **patient with**, **famous / responsible for**, **typical of**, **proud / ashamed of**, **ready / late for**. После предлога глагол стоит в форме **-ing**: good at solving, capable of printing.
body.en: Skill: **good / bad / brilliant / hopeless at**; ability: **capable / incapable of**; interest: **interested in**, **keen on**; success: **successful in**. Qualities: **patient with**, **famous / responsible for**, **typical of**, **proud / ashamed of**, **ready / late for**. After a preposition the verb takes the **-ing** form: good at solving, capable of printing.

examples: I'm not very good at repairing things.
She is capable of doing the job well.
He is interested in art.
Who was responsible for all that noise?
She is good at solving difficult puzzles.
exampleTranslations: Я не очень хорошо умею чинить вещи.
Она способна хорошо справиться с этой работой.
Он интересуется искусством.
Кто отвечал за весь этот шум?
Она хорошо умеет решать сложные головоломки.

body.ru: Сходство: **similar to**; различие: **different from / to**; связь: **married / engaged to**, **close to**, **fond of**; зависимость: **dependent on** (но **independent of**); осведомлённость: **aware / conscious of**, **certain / sure of / about**; количество: **full / short of**, **crowded with**.
body.en: Similarity: **similar to**; difference: **different from / to**; connection: **married / engaged to**, **close to**, **fond of**; dependence: **dependent on** (but **independent of**); awareness: **aware / conscious of**, **certain / sure of / about**; quantity: **full / short of**, **crowded with**.

examples: Your handwriting is similar to mine.
The film was different from what I expected.
Louise is married to an American.
The streets were crowded with tourists.
Many people are dependent on their phones.
exampleTranslations: Твой почерк похож на мой.
Фильм отличался от того, что я ожидал.
Луиза замужем за американцем.
Улицы были заполнены туристами.
Многие люди зависят от своих телефонов.

body.ru: Ревность: **jealous / envious of**; подозрение: **suspicious / critical / tolerant of**; гордость, стыд: **proud / ashamed of**; удивление: **surprised / shocked / amazed / astonished at / by**; удовольствие: **pleased / satisfied / happy / delighted / disappointed with**; отношение к делу: **serious about**, **careful with**, **curious about**; оценка: **popular with**, **suitable for**; благодарность: **grateful for**; реакция: **allergic to**.
body.en: Jealousy: **jealous / envious of**; suspicion: **suspicious / critical / tolerant of**; pride and shame: **proud / ashamed of**; surprise: **surprised / shocked / amazed / astonished at / by**; pleasure: **pleased / satisfied / happy / delighted / disappointed with**; attitude to work: **serious about**, **careful with**, **curious about**; evaluation: **popular with**, **suitable for**; gratitude: **grateful for**; reaction: **allergic to**.

examples: Why is he so jealous of other people?
I wasn't aware of that.
Everybody was surprised at the news.
They were delighted with the present.
exampleTranslations: Почему он так завидует другим людям?
Я об этом не знал.
Все были удивлены этой новостью.
Они были в восторге от подарка.

questions.sentence: Our little dog is afraid ___ loud noises.

translation.ru: Наша маленькая собака боится громких звуков.

explanation.ru: Прилагательное afraid закреплено за предлогом of: afraid of something. Другие предлоги здесь невозможны.
explanation.en: The adjective afraid is fixed with of: afraid of something. No other preposition works in this phrase.

questions.sentence: My parents were very proud ___ my exam results.

translation.ru: Мои родители очень гордились моими результатами на экзаменах.

explanation.ru: Proud of — «гордиться чем-то»: предлог of входит в устойчивое сочетание с proud.
explanation.en: Proud of means feeling pleased about something; the preposition of is part of the fixed phrase.

questions.sentence: My cousin is very interested ___ Japanese culture.

translation.ru: Моя двоюродная сестра очень интересуется японской культурой.

explanation.ru: Interested in — «интересующийся чем-то»; после interested всегда стоит in.
explanation.en: Interested in is the phrase for having an interest in something; interested always takes in.

questions.sentence: My younger brother is really good ___ chess.

translation.ru: Мой младший брат действительно хорошо играет в шахматы.

explanation.ru: Good at — «хорошо уметь что-то делать»; at ставится перед названием навыка или умения.
explanation.en: Good at describes a skill; at comes before the skill or activity: good at chess.

questions.sentence: My cousin is quite bad ___ solving difficult puzzles.

translation.ru: Моя двоюродная сестра довольно плохо решает сложные головоломки.

explanation.ru: Bad at — «плохо уметь что-то»; перед названием навыка ставится at, как и в паре good at.
explanation.en: Bad at means not skilled at something; the skill takes at, just like good at.

questions.sentence: Are you ready ___ the maths test tomorrow?

translation.ru: Ты готов к контрольной по математике завтра?

explanation.ru: Ready for ставится перед существительным: ready for the test. Перед глаголом было бы ready to start.
explanation.en: Ready for is used before a noun: ready for the test. Before a verb we would use ready to start.

questions.sentence: My parents are worried ___ my grandfather's health.

translation.ru: Мои родители волнуются о здоровье дедушки.

explanation.ru: Worried about — «беспокоиться о чём-то»; предлог about закреплён за worried.
explanation.en: Worried about means anxious about something; worried is fixed with about.

questions.sentence: The children are very excited ___ their summer holidays.

translation.ru: Дети очень радуются предстоящим летним каникулам.

explanation.ru: Excited about — «радоваться чему-то, ждать с нетерпением»: предлог about закреплён за excited.
explanation.en: Excited about means looking forward to something; the preposition about is fixed with excited.

questions.sentence: The old attic was full ___ forgotten furniture.

translation.ru: Старый чердак был полон забытой мебели.

explanation.ru: Full of — «полный чего-то»; после full ставится of, а с причастием filled используется filled with.
explanation.en: Full of means containing a lot of something; with the participle filled we use filled with.

questions.sentence: The office manager is responsible ___ ordering new supplies.

translation.ru: Офис-менеджер отвечает за заказ канцелярских товаров.

explanation.ru: Responsible for — «отвечать за что-то»; предлог for закреплён за responsible.
explanation.en: Responsible for means having a duty for something; responsible takes for.

questions.sentence: Regular exercise is very good ___ your heart.

translation.ru: Регулярные физические упражнения очень полезны для сердца.

explanation.ru: Good for — «полезный для чего-то»; о пользе говорим с for, а о навыке — с at.
explanation.en: Good for means beneficial; for is used for benefit, while at is used for skills.

questions.sentence: Too much sugar is bad ___ your teeth.

translation.ru: Слишком много сахара вредно для зубов.

explanation.ru: Bad for — «вредный для чего-то»; вред обозначается предлогом for, а не at.
explanation.en: Bad for means harmful to something; the harm is expressed with for, not at.

questions.sentence: The students were well prepared ___ the final exam.

translation.ru: Студенты были хорошо подготовлены к выпускному экзамену.

explanation.ru: Prepared for — «подготовленный к чему-то»; перед существительным ставится for.
explanation.en: Prepared for means ready for something; before a noun we use prepared for.

questions.sentence: The old church stands very close ___ the river.

translation.ru: Старая церковь стоит очень близко к реке.

explanation.ru: Close to — «близко к чему-то»; после close ставится to.
explanation.en: Close to means near something; close is followed by to.

questions.sentence: The machine is capable ___ printing two hundred pages a minute.

translation.ru: Машина способна печатать двести страниц в минуту.

explanation.ru: Capable of — «способный что-то делать»; после capable идёт of и -ing-форма.
explanation.en: Capable of means able to do something; capable takes of plus an -ing form.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with an example.

pairs.right: My little brother is afraid of spiders.
Our teacher says I am good at drawing.
She became interested in astronomy at school.
The region is famous for its cheese and wine.

explanation.ru: Afraid of, good at, interested in и famous for — предлог закреплён за прилагательным и не меняется по смыслу.
explanation.en: Afraid of, good at, interested in and famous for — the preposition is fixed with the adjective.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with an example.

pairs.right: We are proud of what our students achieved.
The kitchen was full of the smell of fresh bread.
Is everybody ready for the final rehearsal?
The nurses were very kind to the children.

explanation.ru: Proud of, full of, ready for и kind to — устойчивые сочетания прилагательного с предлогом.
explanation.en: Proud of, full of, ready for and kind to are fixed combinations of an adjective with a preposition.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with an example.

pairs.right: I am a bit worried about tomorrow's interview.
The caretaker is responsible for the school building.
Her new bike is similar to mine.
Life in a village is different from life in a city.

explanation.ru: Worried about, responsible for, similar to и different from — зависимые предлоги этих прилагательных.
explanation.en: Worried about, responsible for, similar to and different from are the dependent prepositions of these adjectives.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with an example.

pairs.right: The young engineer is capable of solving complex problems.
The staff were not aware of the new safety rules.
The station is close to the market square.
The customer was satisfied with the service in the café.

explanation.ru: Capable of, aware of, close to и satisfied with — предлог входит в состав каждого сочетания.
explanation.en: Capable of, aware of, close to and satisfied with — the preposition is part of each combination.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with an example.

pairs.right: My cousin has been married to a doctor for five years.
My grandfather is fond of old detective films.
Sorry I'm late for the rehearsal — the bus was delayed.
She always feels nervous about job interviews.

explanation.ru: Married to, fond of, late for и nervous about — предлог закреплён за прилагательным.
explanation.en: Married to, fond of, late for and nervous about — the preposition is fixed with the adjective.

questions.sentence: The valley is famous ___ producing excellent wine.

translation.ru: Долина знаменита производством превосходного вина.

explanation.ru: Famous for — «знаменитый чем-то»; после famous ставится for.
explanation.en: Famous for means well known because of something; famous is followed by for.

questions.sentence: Your jacket looks very similar ___ your brother’s.

translation.ru: Твоя куртка очень похожа на куртку твоего брата.

explanation.ru: Similar to — «похожий на что-то»; после similar ставится to.
explanation.en: Similar to means like something else; similar takes to.

questions.sentence: Our coach was always kind ___ younger players.

translation.ru: Наш тренер всегда был добр к более молодым игрокам.

explanation.ru: Kind to — «добрый к кому-то»; прилагательное kind требует предлога to.
explanation.en: Kind to means treating someone kindly; kind is followed by to.

questions.sentence: The critic was not satisfied ___ the ending of the film.

translation.ru: Критик остался недоволен концовкой фильма.

explanation.ru: Satisfied with — «довольный чем-то»; предлог with закреплён за satisfied.
explanation.en: Satisfied with means pleased about something; satisfied is fixed with with.

questions.sentence: Nobody was aware ___ the hidden camera in the room.

translation.ru: Никто не знал о скрытой камере в комнате.

explanation.ru: Aware of — «знать о чём-то, осознавать»; после aware ставится of.
explanation.en: Aware of means knowing about something; aware is followed by of.

questions.sentence: Her brother got married ___ his childhood friend last summer.

translation.ru: Её брат женился на своей подруге детства прошлым летом.

explanation.ru: Married to — «женатый на ком-то»; после married ставится to.
explanation.en: Married to is the standard phrase for being someone's husband or wife; married takes to.

questions.sentence: She is fond ___ taking long walks in the park.

translation.ru: Она любит долгие прогулки в парке.

explanation.ru: Fond of — «любить что-то»; прилагательное fond всегда с of.
explanation.en: Fond of means liking something; fond always takes of.

questions.sentence: The students were late ___ the geography lesson.

translation.ru: Ученики опоздали на урок географии.

explanation.ru: Late for — «опоздавший на что-то»: late for a lesson, late for work.
explanation.en: Late for means not on time for something: late for a lesson, late for work.

questions.sentence: I always feel nervous ___ flying.

translation.ru: Я всегда нервничаю из-за полётов.

explanation.ru: Nervous about — «нервничать из-за чего-то»; прилагательное nervous сочетается с about.
explanation.en: Nervous about means worried about something; nervous is followed by about.

questions.sentence: By evening the basket was full ___ ripe apples.

translation.ru: К вечеру корзина была полна спелых яблок.

explanation.ru: Full of — «полный чего-то»; после full ставится of.
explanation.en: Full of means containing a lot of something; full is followed by of.

questions.sentence: He is ashamed ___ his behaviour at the party.

translation.ru: Он стыдится своего поведения на вечеринке.

explanation.ru: Ashamed of — «стыдиться чего-либо»; после ashamed ставим of.
explanation.en: Ashamed of means feeling shame about something; ashamed is followed by of.

questions.sentence: She is jealous ___ her sister's success.

translation.ru: Она завидует успеху сестры.

explanation.ru: Jealous of — «завидовать чему-либо»; прилагательное jealous требует of.
explanation.en: Jealous of means envious of something; jealous takes the preposition of.

questions.sentence: Our teacher is very serious ___ our exams.

translation.ru: Наш учитель очень серьёзно относится к нашим экзаменам.

explanation.ru: Serious about — «серьёзно относиться к чему-либо»; после serious ставим about.
explanation.en: Serious about means treating something seriously; serious is followed by about.

questions.sentence: Please be careful ___ the hot plates.

translation.ru: Пожалуйста, будь осторожен с горячими тарелками.

explanation.ru: Careful with — «осторожный с чем-либо»; после careful ставим with.
explanation.en: Careful with means taking care around something; careful takes with.

questions.sentence: This singer is very popular ___ teenagers.

translation.ru: Этот певец очень популярен среди подростков.

explanation.ru: Popular with — «популярный у кого-либо»; после popular ставим with.
explanation.en: Popular with means liked by a group; popular is followed by with.

questions.sentence: Is this film suitable ___ young children?

translation.ru: Этот фильм подходит для маленьких детей?

explanation.ru: Suitable for — «подходящий для чего-либо»; после suitable ставим for.
explanation.en: Suitable for means right for something; suitable is followed by for.

questions.sentence: The little boy is frightened ___ the dark.

translation.ru: Маленький мальчик боится темноты.

explanation.ru: Frightened of — «испуганный чего-либо»; после frightened ставим of.
explanation.en: Frightened of means afraid of something; frightened takes of.

questions.sentence: My brother is very keen ___ football.

translation.ru: Мой брат очень увлекается футболом.

explanation.ru: Keen on — «увлекаться чем-либо»; после keen ставим on.
explanation.en: Keen on means very interested in something; keen takes on.

questions.sentence: The children are curious ___ the world around them.

translation.ru: Дети интересуются окружающим миром.

explanation.ru: Curious about — «любопытный, интересующийся чем-либо»; после curious ставим about.
explanation.en: Curious about means interested in something; curious takes about.

questions.sentence: I am sorry ___ the trouble I caused.

translation.ru: Мне жаль, что я причинил неприятности.

explanation.ru: Sorry for — «сожалеть о чём-либо»; после sorry ставим for.
explanation.en: Sorry for means feeling regret about something; sorry takes for.

questions.sentence: We are grateful ___ all your help.

translation.ru: Мы благодарны за всю вашу помощь.

explanation.ru: Grateful for — «благодарный за что-либо»; после grateful ставим for.
explanation.en: Grateful for means thankful for something; grateful takes for.

questions.sentence: The room was crowded ___ excited children.

translation.ru: Комната была заполнена взволнованными детьми.

explanation.ru: Crowded with — «заполненный чем-либо»; после crowded ставим with.
explanation.en: Crowded with means full of something; crowded takes with.

questions.sentence: My cousin is allergic ___ cats.

translation.ru: У моей двоюродной сестры аллергия на кошек.

explanation.ru: Allergic to — «имеющий аллергию на что-либо»; после allergic ставим to.
explanation.en: Allergic to means reacting badly to something; allergic takes to.

questions.sentence: The manager was polite ___ all the guests.

translation.ru: Менеджер был вежлив со всеми гостями.

explanation.ru: Polite to — «вежливый с кем-либо»; после polite ставим to.
explanation.en: Polite to means showing good manners to someone; polite takes to.

questions.sentence: He was rather rude ___ the waiter.

translation.ru: Он был довольно груб с официантом.

explanation.ru: Rude to — «грубый с кем-либо»; после rude ставим to.
explanation.en: Rude to means impolite towards someone; rude takes to.

questions.sentence: The old man is very generous ___ his time.

translation.ru: Пожилой мужчина очень щедро делится своим временем.

explanation.ru: Generous with — «щедрый в отношении чего-либо»; после generous ставим with.
explanation.en: Generous with means giving a lot of something; generous takes with.

questions.sentence: The library is always full ___ students in the evening.

translation.ru: Вечером библиотека всегда полна студентов.

explanation.ru: Full of — «полный чего-либо»; после full ставим of.
explanation.en: Full of means containing a lot of something; full takes of.

questions.sentence: The team was successful ___ finding a solution.

translation.ru: Команда успешно нашла решение.

explanation.ru: Successful in — «успешный в чём-либо»; после successful ставим in.
explanation.en: Successful in means achieving something; successful takes in.

questions.sentence: The student is dependent ___ his parents.

translation.ru: Студент зависит от своих родителей.

explanation.ru: Dependent on — «зависимый от кого-либо»; после dependent ставим on.
explanation.en: Dependent on means relying on someone; dependent takes on.

questions.sentence: The new teacher is very patient ___ slow learners.

translation.ru: Новая учительница очень терпелива с медлительными учениками.

explanation.ru: Patient with — «терпеливый с кем-либо»; после patient ставим with.
explanation.en: Patient with means tolerant towards someone; patient takes with.
